```python
import griffe
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    tmppath = Path(tmpdir)
    
    subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "download", "click==8.1.7", "-d", tmpdir],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True
    )
    
    wheel = next(tmppath.glob("*.whl"))
    with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as zf:
        zf.extractall(tmppath)
    
    loader = griffe.GriffeLoader()
    package = loader.load_from_path(tmppath / "click")
    print(package.name)
```
